title: Podcast EP365: How Agentrys is Revolutionizing Chip Design with Mark Ren - Semiwiki
gist: SemiWiki podcast episode notes in which Daniel Nenni interviews Mark Ren, founder and CEO of Agentrys and formerly of IBM Research and NVIDIA Research, where he led GPU-accelerated EDA and ChipNeMo; Agentrys claims an automated agentic flow cut power 28%, raised performance 40% and reduced area 10% on an open-source design, and solved attendees' real design problems live at Hot Chips 2026. Note: the record is the episode write-up rather than a verbatim transcript, so claims are as summarized there.

insights.claim: Agentrys demonstrated a design flow built with its own tools that optimized an open-source design by reducing power 28 percent, increasing performance 40 percent and reducing area 10 percent, entirely through an automated agentic flow.
insights.so_what: If reproducible on production designs, PPA gains of that magnitude from agents alone would threaten incumbent EDA pricing and compress design schedules.
insights.quote: reducing power by 28 percent, increasing performance by 40 percent and reducing area by 10 percent, all with an automated, agentic flow
insights.locator: Dan then explores the unique capabilities Agentrys delivered
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni

insights.claim: Agentrys took real design problems from Hot Chips 2026 attendees and developed solutions in its booth during the show, which the interviewer notes is likely the first time any company has done this.
insights.so_what: Live, on-the-spot problem solving is a credibility signal that agentic EDA has moved past canned benchmarks.
insights.quote: Daniel mentioned this is likely the first time any company has done this.
insights.locator: Mark went on to describe how Agentrys took real design problems
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni

insights.claim: Mark Ren argues that AI agents have achieved a substantial improvement in performance and capability in chip design, and that these improvements are what led him to found Agentrys to apply them across a broad range of design problems.
insights.so_what: A capability step-change thesis from an insider who built the first industrial LLM-for-chip-design effort — a leading indicator for EDA disruption.
insights.locator: Daniel explores the changing role of AI in chip design
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni

insights.claim: Agentrys founder and CEO Mark Ren has 26 years of EDA and AI R&D experience spanning IBM Research and NVIDIA Research and received the IBM Corporate Award for contributions to design closure for high-performance microprocessors.
insights.so_what: Deep incumbent pedigree lowers technical risk and raises the odds that established EDA customers will trial the startup.
insights.locator: Daniel is joined by Mark Ren, founder and CEO of Agentrys
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni

insights.claim: At NVIDIA, Mark Ren helped establish the company as a leader in AI for chip design and GPU-accelerated EDA, and led ChipNeMo, described as the first industrial LLM-for-chip-design effort.
insights.so_what: The talent pipeline from NVIDIA Research into EDA startups is where the next disruption of Synopsys/Cadence-style workflows originates.
insights.locator: At NVIDIA, he helped establish the company
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni

insights.claim: Mark Ren spearheaded the modern GPU-accelerated EDA movement, driving adoption of deep-learning frameworks to unlock performance and scalability for EDA workloads.
insights.so_what: Running EDA on deep-learning infrastructure converts design software into a GPU-consuming workload — incremental accelerator demand beyond model training.
insights.locator: Mark has spearheaded the modern GPU-accelerated EDA movement
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni

insights.claim: Agentrys is promoting a webinar titled 'Agents Assemble: Build Your Chip Design Multi-Agent System in 30 Minutes,' positioning multi-agent chip design systems as something customers can assemble themselves in half an hour.
insights.so_what: A self-serve, fast-onboarding go-to-market is unusual in EDA and suggests a land-and-expand motion under incumbent pricing.
insights.quote: Agents Assemble: Build Your Chip Design Multi-Agent System in 30 Minutes
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
